Definition: a Jitsharite or descendant of Jitshar
BiblicalUsage: Yitshârîy means a Jitsharite or descendant of Jitshar. In Numbers 3:27 we read, "And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites..." It appears again in 1 Chronicles 24:22: "Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath."
TheologicalSignificance: Yitshariy is a Jitsharite or descendant of Jitshar, and I believe the God who counts hairs also counts words.
